name: Youngy Health Co., Ltd.
summary: Youngy Health Co., Ltd., established in 1995 and headquartered in Hefei, China, specializes in manufacturing and selling a diverse range of sauna equipment across China. Their product line features various sauna types, including infrared, traditional, foot, and portable steam and infrared options. Beyond saunas, the company also produces air purifiers, carbon heating painting products, functional sofas and chairs, Saunalux brand items, and SUP and boat-related products. Their sauna offerings are distributed globally, reaching approximately 70 countries.
